thread:
maya: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8347 is blocked until architecture/RFC sign-off. RFC linked in PR: https://rfc.redwood.ai/r/2026-07-routing-fallbacks. The change introduces a policy that biases routing to dedicated pools for "tiered" customers and a fallback path to quantized model variants when capacity is constrained. This repo's CI enforces an "rfc-approved" gate so we can't merge without arch ack.

jess: quick question — are we touching any runtime kernel selection here or just policy/routing decisions? want to scope review time.

maya: mostly policy + predicate checks in router/service layer. small change in router/policy.go and a new compatibility predicate in model_compat.go. no kernel/kernelsel changes. feature flag: `runtime.routing.dynamic_pref` to toggle behaviour.

olivia: flag that the fallback predicate needs to validate `max_sequence_length` and `context_window` to avoid serving incompatible quantized variants. Also suggest adding a `fallback_reason` metric so we can tell capacity vs incompatibility.

noah: infra CI flaky: job integration-test:router-fallback timed out earlier. infra-bot printed failure: "router_test.go:156: expected 3 routes, got 2" — rerunning now.

infra-bot: CI retry queued for integration-test:router-fallback. log snippet: "=== RUN TestRouterFallback\n--- FAIL: TestRouterFallback (0.72s)\n    router_test.go:156: expected 3 routes, got 2\n" — retrying build (attempt 2).

maya: thanks infra-bot. I pushed a small test to assert `max_sequence_length` on the fallback path and added a short note in the PR description about perf impact for short sequences. retried CI after fixing test timing.

jess: I'll take the RFC + PR tonight. ETA ~4h. If it's just router + predicate checks, should be a quick review. will either LGTM or request changes.

olivia: reviewed RFC briefly — ok overall. two actionable asks: 1) add the `fallback_reason` metric (labels: capacity|compatibility|policy) and expose it in the console dashboard; 2) document operator rollback steps in the RFC/PR (how to pin routing to hosted variant and disable feature flag during canary).

maya: added metric and a short rollback runbook in the PR. canary plan configured: 1% global, ramp to 5% over 30m if stable. added canary snippet in PR description.

jess: left one nit on log verbosity (don't log entire model proto on debug). otherwise LGTM from arch once CI green. marking PR as mergeable pending infra ack and green CI.

noah: tagging oncall in case fallback produces unexpected routing spikes: @eng-oncall — please watch fallback metrics during canary.

eng-oncall: noted. will add alert for >0.5% of requests hitting fallback with latency delta >100ms.

olivia: one more: keep RFC link in the PR description for audit trail (don't squash it out). :thumbsup:

maya: done — RFC link preserved. will queue merge in Thursday's 09:00 deploy window if CI passes and arch ack present. thanks all.
